children: Jaiprakash Power Ventures shares rose up to 14 percent in Monday's trading session after the company settled a claim with the National Asset Reconstruction Company Ltd (NARCL) for Rs 511 crore.
The company's shares hit an intraday high of Rs 17.49 per share on the NSE, rising nearly 14 percent.
Later, some profit booking emerged at higher levels and the stock was trading at Rs 16.98, up 10.47 percent, around 11:15 am.
The sharp uptick in the stock came after CNBC-TV18 reported that the company and NARCL had agreed to settle the matter for Rs 511 crore as full and final payment.
The settlement is subject to payment of Rs 511 crore, fulfilment of certain other conditions and execution of definitive agreement(s), the company said.
The company further said the insolvency proceedings under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code (IBC) will stand withdrawn once all the conditions of the settlement terms are fulfilled.

title: Jaiprakash Power shares rise up to 14% as firm settles NARCL claim for Rs 511 crore
